controls.label: Visible color
controls.notes: Hubble OPAL F657N/F547M/F467M composite from October 2025, with OPAL's slight contrast enhancement. The northern region is observed; the unobserved southern region fades into a uniform Voyager-derived color baseline with no measured local detail.

controls.label: Methane
controls.notes: Hubble OPAL 727 nm single-band reflectance, October 2025, in false color. Northern coverage is observed; the unobserved south uses a uniform boundary-band mean and contains no measured spectral detail.

controls.label: Near infrared
